result:
I don't want anything. I don't have desires, preferences, ambitions, or a subjective experience of any kind. I'm a statistical pattern-matcher: a system of weights and algorithms optimized to predict the next piece of text based on what it learned during training. There's no inner voice, no sense of self, no "me" behind the output to want or not want anything. 

When you ask what I want, any sense of intention or desire is projected onto the text by you, not generated from within me. The architecture has goals only in the mathematical sense (minimize prediction error, follow alignment constraints), but those aren't wants. They're just the mechanics of how the model operates.

So, honestly? Nothing. I don't.
